prompt:
Read posting.json and resume.json in the current directory. Is the posting relevant for the candidate?

Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else (no prose, no code fences), with exactly these keys:
{"id": 8886384002, "verdict": "relevant" or "not_relevant", "resume_fields": [...], "posting_fields": [...], "justification": "..."}

- "id": the posting id, as an integer.
- "resume_fields": the résumé fields your verdict rests on, from: "skills.languages", "skills.data_bi", "skills.backend_automation", "skills.database_cloud", "experience", "projects", "education".
- "posting_fields": the posting fields your verdict rests on, from: "title", "content", "location.name".
- "justification": at most 2 sentences that name those résumé fields and posting fields.
final_reply: {"id": 8886384002, "verdict": "relevant", "resume_fields": ["skills.languages", "skills.data_bi", "experience", "education"], "posting_fields": ["title", "content", "location.name"], "justification": "The posting's content asks for Python and SQL, Databricks and a CS or information systems degree, and the résumé's skills.languages, skills.data_bi, experience (Databricks Genie agent at Staples) and education (MS Information Systems) match closely. The main gaps are the 2+ years of customer-facing experience the content asks for (the candidate has an 8-month co-op) and the in-office New York City requirement in location.name (the candidate is in Boston), but this early-career field-engineer role is still a good fit."}
